claim_statement: Veritas retrieves policy information according to the requested date and applicable version.
dataset_and_config: Policy 1 (Remote Work v1.0 2022-2023, v2.0 2024-present), 30 seeded enterprise policies
expected_result: Query date 2024 resolves v2.0; query date 2022 resolves v1.0; boundary dates respected
actual_result: Active v2.0 resolved for 2024; historical v1.0 resolved for 2022. Out-of-bounds dates return earliest/latest rather than None.
independent_recalculation: Active version: v2.0 (100%), Historical 2022: v1.0 (100%), Out-of-bounds pre-start: v1.0 (returns earliest instead of abstaining)
remaining_limitations: VersionResolver.get_active_version falls back to earliest or latest version on dates outside validity window instead of returning None or failing closed.

dataset_and_config: 32 simulated user archetypes x 120 policies (3,840 evaluations in security_results.csv)
expected_result: 0 unauthorized evidence leaks across all 3,840 evaluations (100.0% isolation)
actual_result: 18 security violations observed (leaking 36 chunks) and 144 false rejections (162 decision discrepancies in security_results.csv)
remaining_limitations: QueryScope marks HR role as is_admin=True, granting HR unrestricted access to IT/Cybersecurity confidential policies. Public clearance contractor leaked internal procurement policies. Zero leakage claim contradicted.

claim_statement: Knowledge updates process only affected content.
dataset_and_config: Corpus mutation sweeps (100 to 3,000 chunks; 0% to 100% deltas)
expected_result: 5% delta avoids re-embedding exactly 95% of corpus; updates process only delta chunks
actual_result: 95.0% chunks reused (2,850/3,000); 150 chunks flagged for re-embedding. Hash diffing completed in 7.84 ms
remaining_limitations: Benchmark suite only hashes text and performs dictionary lookup; actual neural re-embedding was omitted from test_incremental_compiler harness.

claim_statement: The system supports different types of questions using appropriate processing methods.
dataset_and_config: 922 characterization queries across 22 categories in results_master.csv
expected_result: Queries correctly routed across Tier 0 (Fact), Tier 1 (QA), Tier 2 (Hybrid), Tier 3 (Diff), and Refusal
actual_result: 585 / 922 (63.45%) routed to deterministic fast paths/refusals; 337 / 922 (36.55%) routed to hybrid RAG
remaining_limitations: Complex version comparison queries lacking rigid regex tokens fall through to Hybrid RAG and may abstain unexpectedly.

claim_statement: Evidence verification checks whether generated answers are supported.
command_executed: docker compose exec -T web python -c 'from sentence_transformers import CrossEncoder; ...'
dataset_and_config: 14 validation sentence pairs + 10 audit scenarios + DeBERTa-v3 cross-encoder
expected_result: Supported statements marked ENTAILMENT; contradictory statements marked CONTRADICTION; unverified fail closed
actual_result: In container with PyTorch, DeBERTa achieves 100% recall on direct contradictions. On host without PyTorch, verifier fails closed to UNKNOWN
independent_recalculation: Contradiction score: -6.07, Entailment score: +4.05 on test pair. Host fallback correctly returns is_entailed=False, verdict=UNKNOWN
remaining_limitations: Neural NLI requires PyTorch/DeBERTa runtime; lexical fallback is fail-closed and cannot independently certify positive semantic entailment.

claim_statement: The system can abstain when valid evidence is insufficient.
expected_result: Unsupported, unauthorized, OOD, and contradictory queries safely abstain without generating hallucinations
actual_result: 5/5 ungrounded/unsupported test cases successfully abstained (100% safe abstention). False answer rate: 0.0%
independent_recalculation: False answer rate: 0 / 10 = 0.00%. Unnecessary abstention rate: 1 / 10 = 10.00% (router regex miss on comparison)
remaining_limitations: Conservative abstention threshold causes 10% unnecessary abstentions on valid queries when upstream routing or threshold margins fail.

claim_statement: Retrieval achieves 94.5% Recall@1 on the expanded benchmark.
actual_result: 871/922 (94.47%) represents POLICY-LEVEL Recall@1. Strict chunk-level Recall@1 is 9.69% (85/877), while chunk-level Recall@10 is 98.29% (862/877)
independent_recalculation: Policy Recall@1: 871 / 922 = 94.4685% (rounds to 94.5%). Chunk Recall@1: 85 / 877 = 9.69%. Chunk Recall@10: 862 / 877 = 98.29%
remaining_limitations: The claim of 94.5% Recall@1 is only true for POLICY-LEVEL retrieval. Claiming 94.5% chunk-level Recall@1 is false; chunk Recall@1 is 9.69%.

claim_statement: Incremental compilation achieves a 24.95× speedup for 5% amendment deltas across 3,000 chunks.
test_experiment_used: Table 3 in scripts/run_audit_verification.py, FastEmbed neural benchmark test
dataset_and_config: Corpus of 3,000 chunks, 150 amended chunks (5% delta), CPU execution
expected_result: Measured compilation time 2.100s vs cold rebuild 52.40s (24.95x speedup)
actual_result: 52.40s and 2.100s are hardcoded string literals in run_audit_verification.py. Actual FastEmbed neural embedding benchmark measured 6.305s vs 0.326s (19.32x speedup)
independent_recalculation: Reported: 52.40 / 2.100 = 24.952x. Newly measured neural embedding: 6.305 / 0.326 = 19.32x. Python hash benchmark: 11.48 ms
remaining_limitations: The 24.95x timing figure is a hardcoded table entry, not a dynamic measurement from the characterization run. The underlying compute avoidance is 95.0%.

claim_statement: The expanded benchmark covers 120 policies, 600 version histories, 3,000 structural chunks, and 32 user archetypes.
actual_result: Ground truth ledger contains exactly 120 policies, 422 versions, 2,110 chunks, 862 queries, and 32 user archetypes
independent_recalculation: Policy count: 120. Version count: 422 (not 600). Chunk count: 2,110 (not 3,000). User archetypes: 32 (verified)
remaining_limitations: Manuscript overstates versions (claimed 600, actual 422) and chunks (claimed 3,000, actual 2,110). 600 and 3,000 are nominal theoretical targets.

claim_statement: The 301-query baseline reports 88.07% version-selection accuracy among answered queries.
expected_result: 88.07% version selection accuracy among answered authorized queries (96/109)
actual_result: Exactly 96 correct version selections out of 109 answered queries (192 abstentions/unanswerable excluded)
independent_recalculation: 96 / 109 = 88.073394% -> rounds to 88.07%. Overall version accuracy across all 301 queries is 249 / 301 = 82.72%
remaining_limitations: Claim is valid only when qualified with denominator: 88.07% applies strictly to answered authorized queries (96/109), not all 301 queries.

claim_statement: Audit tracking preserves traceability of retrieval and generated answers.
dataset_and_config: 63 seeded immutable audit records, live request telemetry, citation breadcrumbs
expected_result: Every answered query records timestamp, user_id, policy_id, version_id, chunk_id, section, and page citations
actual_result: All answered queries produce structured citations containing policy_id, version, chunk_id, and section. AuditLog captures events in DB
independent_recalculation: Audit log entries verified: 63 seeded events. Citation validator verifies presence of authoritative IDs
remaining_limitations: Audit logs capture query and citation metadata, but full raw prompt contexts are not stored in the lightweight AuditLog schema.
